confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Palawan tourist-town pricing, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, and the 3-star hotel and wine anchors are the least certain. Cocktail is derived from the beer anchor using an assumed local price relationship of about 2.5 times beer. Prices assume a July rainy-season, low-demand window. FX observation: 0.6955 USD per AUD for 2026-10-15 was taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview page and was not confirmed by opening the page or the F11.1 table; verify before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Palawan leisure towns such as El Nido and Puerto Princesa, adjusted for Coron's smaller size and dive-tourism pricing. Not based on Manila prices.
